mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation_event_day ( EVENT_ID, EVENT_DATE, OPEN_TIME, CLOSE_TIME ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{eventDate}, #{openTime}, #{closeTime} )
INSERT INTO reservation_booth ( BOOTH_NAME, EVENT_ID, POSITION_ROW, POSITION_COL ) VALUES ( #{boothName}, #{eventId}, #{positionRow}, #{positionCol} )
mapper.select: SELECT EVENT_ID, EVENT_NAME, LOCATION, CREATE_DT, UPDATE_DT FROM reservation_event WHERE DELETE_YN = 'N'
SELECT EVENT_ID, EVENT_NAME, LOCATION FROM reservation_event WHERE DELETE_YN = 'N' AND EVENT_ID = #{eventId}
SELECT EVENT_DAY_ID, EVENT_ID, EVENT_DATE, OPEN_TIME, CLOSE_TIME FROM reservation_event_day WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId} ORDER BY EVENT_DATE
